summary: Backend-only testing for RetailPrime ERP against public URL https://inventory-pro-1107.preview.emergentagent.com. Executed 26 pytest cases across shops, dashboard, products, customers, invoices, expenses, transfers, GST report and seed endpoints. All 26 tests PASSED (100%). Verified: (a) 2 shops with 7-day trend arrays and today stats, (b) dashboard has all required KPIs and 30-day trend, (c) product/customer/invoice CRUD + filters (category/search/is_accessory/status) work, (d) invoice creation generates INV-2026-XXXXX numbers AND decrements product.stock (before/after verified) AND updates customer totals, (e) transfer creation generates TRF-XXXX numbers, (f) GST report cgst+sgst==total_gst, (g) POST /api/seed re-seeds with 2 shops / >=70 products / 150 customers / >=500 invoices / >=20 expenses / >=50 transfers, (h) NO _id ever leaks in any response (recursive check on every payload). Note: After running the seed test the DB was refreshed, previously created TEST_* entities are cleared, which is correct behavior.

minor.issue: Accept unvalidated Dict[str, Any] instead of Pydantic models defined in the file (Product/Customer/Invoice/Expense/StockTransfer). Server never enforces required fields or types, so malformed clients can insert junk. Not a blocker for the current MVP but should be tightened by binding the Pydantic models.
invoice_number generated via count_documents() is not concurrency-safe and can collide if two invoices are created simultaneously. Consider an atomic counter (findAndModify) or UUID+sequence.
Stock is decremented without a guard for insufficient stock; can go negative. Consider checking product.stock >= item.quantity before $inc.

IGST is hardcoded to 0 and CGST/SGST are always half of total_gst without checking whether the invoice is inter-state (based on customer GSTIN state code). Acceptable for MVP since seeded data is intra-state Chennai only.

action_items: (Optional/nice-to-have) Bind Pydantic models to POST endpoints for input validation.
(Optional) Make invoice_number / transfer_number generation atomic to avoid race conditions.
(Optional) Prevent invoice creation when item.quantity > product.stock (currently allows negative stock).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 700+ lines and mixes routes + seed logic; consider splitting seed into a separate module.

clean(doc) helper exists but is not needed because every find() already projects {"_id": 0}. On POST endpoints the payload dict was never assigned an _id, so clean() is a no-op there — harmless but confusing.
profit_of() rebuilds prod_map on every call; move it outside the function for O(N) rather than O(N*days).
CORS allow_origins=["*"] with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec (browsers ignore credentials with wildcard). OK for public no-auth API but note for future.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/seed was called by test_seed_and_counts and re-seeded 2 shops, ~72 products, 150 customers, ~800 invoices, ~35 expenses, 54 transfers. This is the last operation in the run and left the DB in a clean seeded state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 26 backend tests currently pass. Test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py loads BASE_URL from /app/frontend/.env (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Every response is recursively checked for _id leak via _no_id() helper. TestSeed runs last and re-seeds the DB. If frontend testing is added later, note that dashboard aggregation is expensive on large invoice sets (currently ~800 invoices, response OK <1s).
